EventFlow Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 4, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Everlight Digital ("we", "us") handles information when you use EventFlow ("EventFlow").

EventFlow is covered by the Everlight Digital Privacy Policy. That policy is the statement of what information Everlight Digital collects, how it is used, which service providers receive it, and what choices you have. This page does not add a separate description of EventFlow's collection, storage, or third parties.

If a later version of this page describes an EventFlow practice in more detail, that more specific statement applies to EventFlow. Until then, the Everlight Digital Privacy Policy controls.
